Job 4 states no Facebook URL, so there are no Facebook-only rows this round. (2) McMahan Cleaners (Denver) was flagged PERMANENTLY CLOSED on its Google profile in the same Job 4 pass; CLOSED_EXCLUDED54 drops its row before slug assignment, so no listing page is generated and the business leaves every surface. Totals move by exactly the one business: listings 5,064 to 5,063, sitemap 6,915 to 6,914, HTML 7,190 to 7,189, search entries 5,064 to 5,063; the totals keys in the v4.7, v5.0, v5.1, v5.2 and v5.3 blocks were revised in place (documented pattern). (3) Open Now (Yelp gap audit row 20, feature side): listings with hours gain a client-side Open now / Closed line above the hours block, computed by OPENNOW_JS from the listing's own rendered day strings in the listing's state timezone (STATE_TZ54: static state map, dominant zone for split states, the honest limit of state-level data); category pages with at least one hours-carrying member gain an 'Open now (hours listed)' rail filter fed by a per-page ytp-hours JSON block, which keeps only listings whose hours say they are open now and excludes listings without determinable hours only while it is on, as the label states.
